SPIKE VERDICT: GREEN (with finding). Wrapping is feasible: instructor state can delegate delta/tool accumulation to polyglot InferenceStreamState, keeping value mgmt, snapshotRevision, memoization, and response construction local. FINDING (executable proof): the accumulators have ALREADY drifted — (A) repeated-name tool deltas: instructor fragments into N tools, polyglot correctly continues one (activeName check); (B) args arriving before any tool key: instructor silently drops them, polyglot buffers via pendingToolArgs. Polyglot's is the hardened implementation. E1 therefore is a bug-fix-direction behavior change: adopt polyglot semantics, pin with characterization tests. Needs additive polyglot accessors: content(), reasoningContent(), toolKey().

Accumulators deduplicated: StructuredOutputStreamState (280 -> 184 LOC) now delegates all delta/tool/usage accumulation to polyglot InferenceStreamState (single owner of tool-key semantics); instructor layer keeps value mgmt, snapshotRevision, memoization, response construction. Additive polyglot accessors: content(), reasoningContent(), toolKey(). BEHAVIOR FIX (bug-fix direction, from E0 spike): repeated-name tool deltas no longer fragment into multiple tools; pre-key args buffered instead of dropped. Pinned in tests/Unit/Streaming/StreamStateToolSemanticsTest.php. 944 tests green across instructor+polyglot; Gates green.
